arguments.sql_query:
-- Find methotrexate concept_id
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%methotrexate%'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
LIMIT 10;

-- Find ALT-specific measurement concept_id and related LFT measurements
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alt%'
   AND standard_concept = 'S'
LIMIT 20;

-- Find the measurement concept ID for ALT (alanine aminotransferase)
SELECT DISTINCT mc.concept_id, mc.concept_name, v.vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept mc
JOIN omop.concept_class cc ON mc.class_id = cc.class_id
WHERE mc.standard_concept = 'S'
  AND LOWER(mc.concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
LIMIT 10;
